messages:
deploy-bot: 🚨 auto-hold triggered for rollout 2026-02-release-3 — anomaly: eu-west p95 request error ↑ 4x. Holding all in-flight canaries.
Maria G.: on it. what region(s) impacted?
deploy-bot: affected: eu-west-1 primary, small spillover to eu-central. canaries in us-west not impacted.
Raj P.: do we have an immediate rollback candidate or should we pin and re-run canaries?
Zane (ops): do NOT rollback globally yet. Hold the rollout and pin the current prod revision to 2026-02-release-2-stable. Investigate root cause in eu-west first.
Emily C.: +1 to pin. Can we flip affected hosts to fallbacks and keep canaries stopped?
Maria G.: plan: 1) pin prod to stable rev 2) freeze new deploys for 2 hours 3) run targeted debug on eu-west canaries 4) after triage decide partial rollback or canary swap.
Maria G.: command to pin (if anyone needs it):
```
redwoodctl release pin --env=prod --version=2026-02-release-2-stable --reason="auto-hold eu-west anomaly"
```
Raj P.: I'll run that in 30s and post output.
Raj P.: pinned ✅. Output: "release prod pinned to 2026-02-release-2-stable (by raj_p)"
Zane (ops): good. Ops action: isolate eu-west TP lanes, collect kcaches and logs for 10m window. Oncall please pull sample traces for 12:04-12:12 UTC.
oncall-bot: @Zane (ops) traces pulled and uploaded: https://s3.redwood/incident/2169999123/traces.tar.gz
Maria G.: changing release window: original schedule 01:00-03:00 UTC now rescheduled to fallback window 03:30-05:30 UTC to give team time. Canaries remain paused until triage signoff.
Emily C.: I'll update release notes and the changelog with pinned version + incident note. Assigning to myself: will push an updated draft to the release PR and tag @eng-oncall for signoff.
Raj P.: quick question — can we do a limited rollout to eu-central only once we have signoff? or should we keep both eu zones frozen?
Zane (ops): freeze both eu zones. We can consider targeted eu-central retry after we've verified the fix on canaries in a synthetic cluster. No cross-region traffic until clearance.
Maria G.: also adding safety measure: set temporary routing policy to prefer us-west for new traffic originating from EU while we triage. Ops, is that configurably safe?
Zane (ops): yes, using routing flag: `--prefer-region=us-west` for 2 hours. Will apply after pinned state is confirmed.
Emily C.: release PR updated with note: "Pinned to stable due to eu-west errors; rollout paused and rescheduled to 03:30-05:30 UTC. Investigations ongoing." Link: https://git.redwood/release-2026/PR-482
Maria G.: thumbs: :thumbsup: Once triage completes, we decide: (A) unfreeze and resume canary in eu-central only, (B) partial rollback of the queued image in eu-west, or (C) full rollback if we see persistent errors. We aim for decision within the 2h hold.
Raj P.: I'll run the perf and heap diffs on the suspect revision, posting logs in 15m.
Zane (ops): ops will schedule a short postmortem if this turns into a regression. For now, documenting timeline here.
deploy-bot: reminder: blocked deploys count = 8 pipelines; auto-notify to stakeholders sent.
Maria G.: thanks all. keep posts concise on this thread. if anyone needs to escalate call, ping me and I'll spin up a bridge.
Emily C.: noted. will ping when PR is approved for re-run.
oncall-bot: scheduled reschedule event created: new window 2026-02-14 03:30:00 UTC — 2026-02-14 05:30:00 UTC, correlation id 2169999123-resched. Notification sent to #product and #support.
